input.command: grep -n "mod " tests/builder.rs 2>/dev/null | head; ls tests/*.rs 2>/dev/null; find tests -maxdepth 1 -name "*.rs"
ls tests/builder/ | grep -i main; cat tests/builder/main.rs 2>/dev/null | head -20; rm -f tests/builder/repro_unknown.rs

grep -n "SetTrue\|fn action\|fn value_parser\b" clap_builder/src/builder/arg.rs | grep -n "action" | head -20
grep -n "fn action(" clap_builder/src/builder/arg.rs
cargo test --test builder repro_unknown_arg_no_use 2>&1 | tail -20 && cargo test --test builder unknown_argument 2>&1 | tail -20
